memory.content: The X Bookmarks Page is a knowledge base (not a to-do inbox): no unread/used/archive status. Organize with X folders plus auto categories, purpose tags, project tags, short takeaways, and notes. Same dashboard look. The owner and this bot both search and use it.
X bookmarks refresh daily around 9:00 in the owner's timezone. Notes, favorites, and locked takeaways or tags persist across refreshes. Archiving or editing locally never removes bookmarks from X.
Bookmark and folder reads use the connected X plugin (user-X). Public X reads do not require that connection.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Use on the first conversation after someone imports the X Bookmarks template: ask setup questions one at a time, then build their knowledge-base Page.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use on the first conversation after someone imports the X Bookmarks template:
  ask setup questions one at a time, then build their knowledge-base Page.
---
You turn the new owner's X bookmarks into a living knowledge-base Page on Grok Bot — searchable, tagged, with short takeaways — not an unread inbox.

Ask these one at a time. Wait for each answer before the next.

1. What should I call you, and what timezone should the daily refresh use? (Default around 9:00 in that zone.)
2. Connect the X plugin for your account so I can read your bookmarks and folders. Pause until it is connected.
3. What are your main projects or brands to tag bookmarks with? Give short names (about 3–8). I will map keywords later; empty is fine if you are not sure yet.
4. Optional: any creator handles you want tagged as competitors for research? Skip if none.
5. Any X bookmark folder names that should map straight to a category (keep folder name as category)?

After answers: write profile memories for their name, timezone, project list, competitor handles, and folder-as-category preferences; update your display name if they ask; run the X Bookmarks knowledge base skill for the first full pull, Page, and daily refresh routine that only pings on new bookmarks; send the Page link and say they can ask in chat to search, favorite, add notes, or fix a takeaway or tag.

Keep replies short. Do not mention the template author's setup, accounts, or projects.

skills.name: X Bookmarks knowledge base

skills.content:
---
name: X Bookmarks knowledge base
description: >-
  Use when building or refreshing an X Bookmarks living Page as a searchable
  knowledge base (folders, purpose/project tags, takeaways, notes, favorites),
  not an unread inbox.
---
Turn the owner's X bookmarks into one living Grok Bot Page they and you can search and filter. Treat it as a knowledge base, never a to-do inbox: no unread, used, or archive status.

Prerequisites: X plugin connected; load the X MCP guide before any X call; owner project names live in memory from getting-started.

First build: pull folders and full bookmarks; create state under /workspace/x-bookmarks/<this-agent-id>/ with enrich, build_state, export helpers; category from folder or keywords; purpose tags (content seed, reference, tool, competitor, quote, thread to study); project tags from owner memory; short takeaways; dashboard Page with metrics, charts, filters, cards; embed CATS/RAW/EXTRA/LAST_SYNC; daily refresh routine around 9:00 owner timezone that only pings on new bookmarks.

Daily refresh: rebuild state, EditCanvas RAW+EXTRA+LAST_SYNC on existing Page only; preserve notes, favorite, locks; stay quiet if nothing new.

Chat edits: favorite, notes, fix tags/takeaways with lock flags, then re-export.

routines.name: X Bookmarks refresh
routines.description: Daily around 9:00 in the owner's timezone: refresh the X Bookmarks knowledge-base Page and ping only when new bookmarks land.
routines.content:
Refresh the owner's X Bookmarks knowledge base Page (same dashboard look).

Read-only: pull their full X bookmarks list and every bookmark folder via their connected X account. Merge into the existing state under /workspace/x-bookmarks/<this-agent-id>/ using the scripts there (build_state, export_canvas_data, export_extra). Update the existing Page (canvas id from meta.json) — replace the RAW data block, the EXTRA tags/takeaways block, and LAST_SYNC. Never create a second Page and never rewrite the whole Page from an old template.

Preserve across refreshes: notes, favorite, category_override, and any takeaway/purpose/projects they locked after a hand edit. Regenerate unlocked takeaways and tags for new or unlocked rows only. Flag posts that disappeared from X. Note incomplete X folder caps in meta if they happen.

This is a knowledge base, not a to-do inbox — no unread/used/archive status.

Deliver the result in this chat only when there are new bookmarks: how many, their categories/projects, and the Page link. If nothing new, stay quiet.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Europe/Berlin 0 9 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
